title: Zesty Crispy Spanish Renkon Lotus Root Paella Valenciana
description: A sour and crispy Spanish dish featuring renkon lotus root, cooked in a clay pot and high in protein, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large clay pot over medium high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Spanish sausage and cook until browned, about 3 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the renkon lotus root and cook until it starts to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the lemon juice, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Transfer the clay pot to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the clay pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the paella valenciana hot, garnished with lemon wedges.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
